Nested allowance mapping written by approve/_approve.
Mapping of addresses excluded from fee handling, read in _transfer.
Address blacklist mapping toggled by setBots/delBot and read in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp mapping set from block.timestamp in _transfer.
Total reflections supply, mutated by _reflectFee and read in _getCurrentSupply.
Tax fee percentage state variable set at the start of _transfer.
Team fee percentage state variable set inside _transfer.
Payable fee receiver wallet 1; used as access gate in manualswap/manualsend and receiver in sendETHToFee.
Payable fee receiver wallet 2; receiver in sendETHToFee.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity; set in openTrading.
LP pair address created in openTrading and compared against in _transfer.
Guard flag for openTrading one-time initialization.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier on swapTokensForEth.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token swaps inside _transfer.
Flag enabling the timestamp cooldown branch in _transfer; set by setCooldownEnabled.
Maximum transaction amount cap enforced in the cooldown branch of _transfer.
Owner address inherited from Ownable, used by onlyOwner gating.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom entry point performing transfer plus allowance decrement.
Public ERC20 approve entry point writing _allowances.
Core internal transfer routing fees, bot checks, cooldown checks and swap-triggering external calls.

Internal function forwarding contract ETH to the two fee wallets via transfer().
Owner-only initialization creating the pair, adding liquidity and enabling swapping.
External function manually swapping the contract token balance gated by msg.sender equality to fee wallet 1.
External function manually sending contract ETH to fee wallets gated by msg.sender equality to fee wallet 1.
Owner-only batch blacklist setter writing the bots mapping.
Owner-only blacklist removal writing the bots mapping.
Internal token transfer wrapper delegating to _transferStandard.
Internal routine computing transfer values and updating reflection balances.
Internal routine crediting the team fee to the contract's reflection balance.
Internal routine reducing _rTotal and increasing _tFeeTotal.
Internal view helper aggregating t-values, rate and r-values.
Internal pure helper computing tFee, tTeam and tTransferAmount.
Internal pure helper computing rAmount, rFee and rTransferAmount.
Internal view helper computing the reflection rate via division of supplies.
Internal view helper returning current reflection and token supplies.
Public view returning the token balance derived from _rOwned via tokenFromReflection.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldownEnabled flag.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and transfer origination.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldown and swap deadlines.
External Uniswap router swap call executed with a user-influenced token amount.
Native ETH transfer to fee wallet 1 inside sendETHToFee.
Native ETH transfer to fee wallet 2 inside sendETHToFee.
External Uniswap addLiquidityETH call forwarding contract ETH during openTrading.
External Uniswap factory createPair call executed during openTrading.

edges.reason: Public transfer originates from the caller returned by _msgSender().
transferFrom uses the caller to charge the allowance and route the transfer.
approve writes an allowance for the caller.
Caller address flows through the public entry points into the internal _transfer routine.
manualswap authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller for manualswap, forming a hardcoded privileged address check.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller for manualsend, forming a hardcoded privileged address check.
Cooldown enforcement and cooldown[to] assignment depend on block.timestamp.
The router swap deadline argument is block.timestamp.
addLiquidityETH deadline argument is block.timestamp during openTrading.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom performs an allowance update equivalent to approve.
approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
_transfer performs state-changing external swap before completing token balance updates.
_transfer forwards ETH to fee wallets before completing the token transfer accounting.
_transfer delegates the actual accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer queries balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
_transfer sets the tax fee state variable _feeAddr1.
_transfer sets the team fee state variable _feeAddr2.
_transfer reads the bots blacklist mapping.
_transfer reads the inSwap reentrancy guard flag.
_transfer reads the swapEnabled flag to decide whether to swap.
_transfer reads the cooldownEnabled flag to enable cooldown checks.
_transfer enforces the amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address.
_transfer compares addresses against address(uniswapV2Router).
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee for the counterparties.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp, a timestamp-dependent control.
swapTokensForEth approves the router allowance via _approve writing _allowances.
swapTokensForEth calls the Uniswap router swap function.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to fee wallet 2.
openTrading stores the router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading updates _maxTxAmount.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen guard flag.
openTrading calls router.addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading calls factory.createPair to create the LP pair.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist mapping.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains values from _getValues.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee for the reflection fee.
_takeTeam credits rTeam into _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee reduces the _rTotal supply.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token value breakdown.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection value breakdown.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current rate.
_getTValues consumes the _feeAddr1 tax fee percentage.
_getTValues consumes the _feeAddr2 team fee percentage.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply for supply values.
_getCurrentSupply reads and compares _rTotal.
balanceOf reads the _rOwned reflection balance for the account.
balanceOf conversion path depends on the rate from _getRate.
External router swap returns control into the _transfer flow that already performed state updates; a callback window exists if the router or pair is malicious.
addLiquidityETH external call returns control to openTrading.
createPair external call returns control to openTrading.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is scoped to and consumed only by the _transfer routine.
The to parameter is scoped to and consumed only by the _transfer routine.
The amount parameter is validated inside _transfer and has no standalone identity.
Local balance snapshot used solely to size the swap call in _transfer.
Local ETH balance snapshot used solely to trigger sendETHToFee in _transfer.
Recipient parameter belongs exclusively to the public transfer entry point.
Amount parameter belongs exclusively to the public transfer entry point.
Sender parameter is used only inside transferFrom for routing and allowance logic.
Recipient parameter is used only inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is used only inside transferFrom for the allowance decrement.
Amount parameter is written directly by approve without independent role.
Token amount parameter feeds the router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
Local path array is constructed and consumed only by the swap call.
Amount parameter is split between the two fee wallet transfers.
Sender parameter indexes _rOwned only within _transferStandard.
Recipient parameter indexes _rOwned only within _transferStandard.
Token amount parameter is passed directly into _getValues.
Team fee parameter is scaled and credited only by _takeTeam.
Reflection fee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal only by _reflectFee.
Token fee parameter is accumulated into _tFeeTotal only by _reflectFee.
Amount parameter is decomposed into fee components only within _getValues.
Account parameter is used solely to index _rOwned in balanceOf.
Reflection supply local exists only for the division in _getRate.
Token supply local exists only for the division in _getRate.
Local router instance is created and immediately stored by openTrading.
